_comment: S0 — semantics, preprocessing and runtime gate. Wrapper validation on a four-image sanity set, NOT a benchmark. Nothing here ranks a model.

extraction.resample: cv2.INTER_AREA in LINEAR light (uw.colorspace.srgb_to_linear -> resize -> linear_to_srgb), then written as 8-bit sRGB PNG
extraction.why_srgb_png: COLMAP and every third-party geometry model expect ordinary display-referred images. The linear-light invariant governs the resample itself (area-averaging radiance), not the interchange encoding. No restoration measurement is made from these files.
extraction.sampling: np.linspace(start, end, n_frames) rounded to unique integer source frame indices; the source index is preserved in the filename so nothing is silently renumbered.

frozen_set_check.reference_status: PROVISIONAL MULTI-VIEW HYPOTHESIS, not ground truth. Agreement with it means consistency with the current Week-3 hypothesis, never objective correctness (MONO_DEPTH_FREEZE.md 7).

semantics.native_meaning: relative depth, larger is farther. The MAIN DA3 series pairs this field with predicted rays and its own `unproject_depth` treats it as PLANAR z-depth. This monocular checkpoint emits no rays and no camera, so that code path is never reached and the convention is NOT established by the wrapper. S2 settles it by measurement.
semantics.canonical_range: NONE HERE. The head is output_dim=1 with no camera branch, so there is no intrinsics to convert with. Supplying an invented focal would manufacture a radial error.
semantics.emits: depth and sky only; intrinsics, extrinsics and conf are all None
semantics.ray_word_warning: DA3's 'ray' is UNNORMALISED and pairs with z-depth. FoundationGeo's 'ray' is UNIT and pairs with range. The two are not interchangeable.
semantics.documented_ambiguity: affine in depth / Class 3: the DA3 teacher outputs scale-shift-invariant DEPTH and the mono student is trained from those targets
semantics.e1_family: d' = s*d + t (S2 also tests the s-only subgroup empirically)
semantics.confidence: prediction.conf where the checkpoint emits one
semantics.claimed_scale: relative; is_metric is recorded per frame
semantics.view_count: strictly 1 — a one-element image list, count asserted

preprocessing_declared.resize_rule: upper_bound_resize toward process_res with patch-size rounding; outputs stay on the PROCESSED grid, not the source grid, so a source->grid map is required to evaluate

provenance.reference_impl_modifications: two, both packaging-only and neither touching the model: (1) pyproject requires-python widened from '<=3.13' to '<3.14' so it installs on CPython 3.13.5; (2) the pycolmap-backed COLMAP EXPORT import in utils/export/__init__.py made optional, because importing pycolmap alongside torch aborts on macOS with a duplicate libomp. The export path is never used here. Patch: patches/da3_no_pycolmap_and_python313.patch

semantics.native_meaning: Larger is NEARER. Scale AND offset are free; the documented ambiguity is affine in disparity.
semantics.legal_alignment: q' = a*q + b fitted in DISPARITY space, then inverted
semantics.illegal_alignment: a*d + b fitted in physical depth. Doing that would be a different transform group, not a stricter one.
semantics.range_conversion: NONE HERE. No canonical range is written, because there is no honest range before the S2 policy fixes (a,b).
semantics.camera: no intrinsics, no FOV, no point map, no confidence
semantics.output_grid: SOURCE resolution — the model interpolates back up

preprocessing_declared.resize_rule: Resize longest/both sides toward input_size with ensure_multiple_of=14, keep_aspect_ratio=True, then normalise. NO crop: the aspect ratio is preserved and the output is interpolated back to the source (H,W).
preprocessing_declared.fov_loss_expected: none — full frame retained, verified in S0

semantics.z_trap: `depth_metric` in the release is points_metric[..., 2], i.e. Z-DEPTH. It is stored here only as `depth_z_metric` and is never used as a range.
semantics.naming_trap: `points_pre_field` in the release is the geometry before the learned RAY correction, not merely before the scale field, and it has been through its OWN focal/shift recovery.
semantics.ray_word_warning: FoundationGeo's ray is a UNIT ray paired with RANGE (d = ||p||). DA3's ray is unnormalised and pairs with z-depth. Opposite conventions, same word.
semantics.v4b_ray_correction: raw pre-delta vs raw post-delta geometry from ONE forward pass, both put through the SAME frozen (focal, shift) recovered from the post-delta arm
semantics.v4c_scale_field: points_post_ray_common vs points_post_ray_common * scalefield — a same-tensor intervention
semantics.ray_correction_cap: the applied angular perturbation is delta_max_rad * tanh(delta_raw), capped at ~3 degrees. The `delta` tensor itself is RAW and unbounded; `delta_raw` stores it, and `ray_turn_deg_*` reports the angle the rays actually turned.
semantics.claimed_scale: metric; PROVISIONAL pre-C2 on this camera
semantics.fov: the model CONSUMES intrinsics optionally; with fov_x=None it recovers focal and shift from the point map itself

preprocessing_declared.loader: cv2.imread -> RGB -> /255 -> (1,3,H,W); the model resizes internally
preprocessing_declared.resize_rule: bicubic resize to a num_tokens-derived resolution, rounded to a multiple of 16 for DINOv3, then outputs interpolated back to the SOURCE (H,W)
preprocessing_declared.fov_loss_expected: none — aspect ratio preserved, no crop; verified in S0
preprocessing_declared.use_fp16: False (the reference default is True; overridden for reproducibility)

provenance.role: point-map candidate + V4b/V4c same-checkpoint internal ablations
provenance.code_license: MIT. The LICENSE file is byte-identical to MoGe's template and reads 'Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation' despite HKU authorship; the MIT grant itself is unambiguous.
provenance.reference_impl_modifications: none to the vendored code. `infer()` is NOT called: this backend calls `model.forward()` and reimplements the postprocessing tail so that both ray-correction arms share one frozen (focal, shift) solution. Calling `infer()` would have produced two independently postprocessed arms, which FREEZE C3 explicitly forbids treating as a ray-correction ablation.

semantics.native_field: point map built as K^-1[u,v,1] * depth, from the model's own PLANAR z-depth head and its decoded pixel intrinsics
semantics.z_field: preds['depth'] is PLANAR z-depth, not range
semantics.confidence: preds['depth_conf'], learned; NOT calibrated for this domain
semantics.claimed_scale: NOT established here. The model was trained multi-view and the released evaluation aligns before scoring; native ambiguity is an S2 measurement, not an inheritance.
semantics.training_caveat: not trained with single-image supervision; FLSea is in its training pool though its evaluation scenes are held out
semantics.view_count: strictly 1 — asserted on the preprocessed tensor

preprocessing_declared.mode_rationale: Wat3R's README uses mode='max'; Week 3 uses 'crop' because that branch is identical to VGGT's, which keeps the family comparison on identical pixels. Kept for Week 4 so this arm differs from the Week-3 product ONLY in view count.
preprocessing_declared.resize_rule: resize so the SHORT side reaches 518 rounded to a multiple of 14, then centre-crop the long side to 518
preprocessing_declared.fov_loss_expected: substantial on PORTRAIT sources — Week 3 lost 10/25 FOV markers at 1280x720. Measured in S0, not assumed.

provenance.naming_note: Ren et al. ECCV 2026. A second unrelated 2026 method is also called WAT3R (Xu et al.); Week 3 records this one as wat3r_ren.

checkpoint_integrity._comment: Tensor-level comparison of the MetricAnything Student-PointMap checkpoint against stock MoGe-2 ViT-L. Mandated by MONO_DEPTH_FREEZE.md C5 because Week 4A's V5 comparison assumes the two share an architecture and a representation.
checkpoint_integrity.verdict_meaning: LINEAGE_CONSISTENT: identical model_config, identical parameter key set, no shape mismatches, and the files are not the same file — everything V5 needs in order to be a controlled architecture/representation comparison. It does NOT establish which component of the fine-tuning treatment caused any downstream difference; FREEZE C5 keeps data, objectives, supervision and camera diversity confounded.
